CAN_ADMIN_SG.description: Can change security-group rules (network exposure). Targets the SG (was the instance).

CAN_ASSUME_WEB_IDENTITY.description: AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity admitted by the trust policy; props.admits = any | pattern | specific.

CAN_INVOKE.description: Invoke only. Never traversable: invoking a function does not give its role.

COGNITO_PUBLIC_IDENTITY.description: Anyone can get identities from the pool (AllowUnauth, or a public authenticated path).

EBS_SHARED_PUBLIC.description: createVolumePermission for all. Normalised anonymous → snapshot.

EC2_FULL_ACCESS.description: ec2:* on the instance: user-data change plus stop/start gives code execution.

ENCRYPTED_BY.description: Default bucket encryption key (resolved KMS id).

EXPOSES.description: Internet-facing load balancer forwards to the target.

GRANTS_PUBLIC.description: Public bucket policy or public ACL (BPA-aware). Normalised anonymous → bucket.

INSTANCE_ROLE.description: Code on the instance gets the instance-profile role's credentials from IMDS. ARN-resolved; the dashboard's name-matched copy is removed.

INVOKES.description: API route proxies to the (unqualified) function.

LAMBDA_GRANTS_PUBLIC.description: Public invoke (function policy or NONE-auth URL). Normalised anonymous → function.

NOTIFIES.description: Bucket event notification: writing an object injects input, it does not give control.

POOL_UNAUTH_ROLE.description: Unauthenticated identities get the role (emitted only when AllowUnauth is true).

PUBLIC_INBOUND.description: Reachable from the internet (security groups, routes, NACLs, scheme, endpoint access). INTERNET_FACING is folded into props.igw_routed.

SERVICE_CAN_ASSUME.description: The trust policy admits an AWS service principal (PassRole candidates, confused-deputy checks).

SG_ALLOWS_FROM.description: Members of the source group can reach members of the target group.

SSRF_TO_IMDS.description: Public, running instance with IMDSv1 and a role: SSRF can read role credentials. Always conditional. Re-aimed from instance→role (dashboard) to anonymous→instance.

USES_ROLE.description: The compute resource runs as the role (Lambda execution role, ECS task role, stack service role, job role). The ECS execution role is EXECUTION_ROLE.

evaluation_gaps.detail: APIs without per-method/route authorisation data (old report or a failed call): unauthenticated routes cannot be listed.
The report predates _coverage.json: denied or failed collection cannot be told apart from empty data.
Identity policies of external principals are not visible; cross-account edges are conditional.
IAM was collected with the per-entity (d13c215) layout: no policy versions, no identity providers, boundaries and tags may be missing
Resource control policies are unknown (membership unknown)
Service control policies are unknown (membership unknown)
Condition values known only at request time (source IP, MFA, tags in the request) are not evaluated; such decisions are conditional.
Session policies passed at AssumeRole time can only narrow permissions and are not modelled.

findings.description: Guest access is enabled: anyone on the internet can obtain credentials for arn:aws:iam::123456789012:role/demo-guest-role.
findings.remediation: Remove the unauthenticated role or tightly scope it; set AllowUnauthenticatedIdentities=false if anonymous access isn't required.
findings.title: Cognito identity pool 'demo_guest_pool' grants an unauthenticated role

findings.description: Full EC2 control
findings.remediation: Restrict to specific actions and resource ARNs
findings.title: Full EC2 control

findings.description: The snapshot's createVolumePermission includes the 'all' group: anyone can create a volume from it and read the data.
findings.remediation: Remove the public createVolumePermission and set snapshot Block Public Access to block-all-sharing.
findings.title: EBS snapshot 'snap-0a1b2c3d4e5f6bb01' is shared publicly

findings.description: Instance 'i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6eb01' (running) has public address(es) 203.0.113.10; security group(s) sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f6eb01 admit 0.0.0.0/0 on 22/tcp.
findings.remediation: Restrict the security-group ingress to specific source ranges, or move the instance behind a load balancer in a private subnet.
findings.title: Instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6eb01 is reachable from the internet on 22/tcp

findings.description: The function URL needs no authentication and the function policy lets unauthenticated callers invoke it: anyone on the internet can run the function.
findings.remediation: Set the function URL AuthType to AWS_IAM, or remove the public InvokeFunctionUrl permission and the URL if it is not needed.
findings.title: Lambda 'demo-url-fn' has a public function URL (AuthType NONE)

findings.description: PubliclyAccessible is true: the endpoint resolves to a public address and is reachable from the internet wherever its security groups allow it.
findings.remediation: Set PubliclyAccessible=false and place the database in private subnets.
findings.title: RDS instance 'demo-public-db' is publicly accessible

findings.description: The snapshot's restore attribute includes 'all': any AWS account can restore it and read the data.
findings.remediation: Remove public sharing from the snapshot immediately.
findings.title: RDS snapshot 'demo-public-snap' is shared publicly

findings.description: S3 bucket 'demo-public-bucket' gives anyone on the internet CAN_READ (actions: s3:getobject); not verified: s3:account-public-access-block-unknown.
findings.remediation: Remove the wildcard Principal or scope it with a principal-restricting condition (aws:PrincipalOrgID, aws:SourceVpce, aws:SourceArn); keep Block Public Access (RestrictPublicBuckets) on at account level.
findings.title: Bucket 'demo-public-bucket' is public through its bucket policy (CAN_READ)

findings.description: S3 bucket 'demo-public-bucket' gives anyone on the internet CAN_READ; not verified: s3:account-public-access-block-unknown.
findings.remediation: Remove the AllUsers / AuthenticatedUsers ACL grants, set Object Ownership to BucketOwnerEnforced (ACLs disabled) and turn on IgnorePublicAcls.
findings.title: Bucket 'demo-public-bucket' ACL grants anyone on the internet (READ)

findings.description: Web identity provider cognito-identity.amazonaws.com can assume 'demo-guest-role'; cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:aud missing, cognito-identity.amazonaws.com:amr admits unauthenticated identities.
findings.remediation: Require the provider's audience (<host>:aud) and an exact subject (<host>:sub), e.g. repo:<org>/<repo>:ref:refs/heads/main for GitHub or system:serviceaccount:<ns>:<sa> for EKS.
findings.title: Role 'demo-guest-role' trusts cognito identities (any subjects)

findings.description: This report predates per-method authorisation data: the API has Lambda integrations and no authorizer object, so its routes may be unauthenticated (AWS_IAM methods need no authorizer object; re-collect to decide per route).
findings.remediation: Attach an authorizer (IAM, Cognito, JWT or Lambda) to the listed routes, or confirm that unauthenticated access is intended.
findings.title: API 'demo-open-api' has Lambda integrations and no authorizer object

findings.description: Instance 'i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6eb01' (running) has HttpTokens 'optional' with the metadata endpoint enabled: SSRF can read the instance role's temporary credentials.
findings.remediation: Set HttpTokens to 'required' to enforce IMDSv2 (or disable the metadata endpoint).
findings.title: Instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6eb01 allows IMDSv1 (instance role exposed to SSRF)

findings.description: Instance 'i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6eb01' has public address(es) 203.0.113.10 and its subnet's effective route table routes to an attached internet gateway.
findings.remediation: Move the instance to a private subnet or remove its public address.
findings.title: Instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f6eb01 has a public address in an internet-routed subnet

findings.description: Instance 'i-0a1b2c3d4e5f60f03' has instance profile 'arn:aws:iam::123456789012:instance-profile/demo-deleted-profile' but no role could be resolved: the instance profile is not among the collected ones (deleted, or in another account).
findings.remediation: Verify the instance profile exists and contains a role; ensure the enumerator has iam:ListInstanceProfiles permission.
findings.title: Instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f60f03 has an unresolved instance profile

findings.description: The load balancer scheme is 'internet-facing': its listeners are reachable from the internet and forward to its targets.
findings.remediation: Confirm the public exposure is intended; otherwise use an internal scheme, and protect it with a WAF web ACL.
findings.title: Load balancer 'demo-public-alb' is internet-facing

findings.description: Can take over an existing EC2 instance with an instance profile and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
findings.remediation: Restrict ssm:StartSession / ssm:SendCommand / ec2-instance-connect:SendSSHPublicKey to specific instances (tags or ARNs) and keep privileged instance profiles off shared instances
findings.title: Instance command execution: Can take over an existing EC2 instance with an instance profile and run code or API calls as the role it runs as

findings.description: Can take over an existing EC2 instance with an instance profile and run code or API calls as the role it runs as
findings.remediation: Restrict ec2:ModifyInstanceAttribute together with Stop/StartInstances on instances with privileged roles
findings.title: Instance user-data rewrite: Can take over an existing EC2 instance with an instance profile and run code or API calls as the role it runs as

findings.description: StorageEncrypted is false: data at rest and its snapshots are not protected by KMS.
findings.remediation: Recreate the database (or restore an encrypted copy of a snapshot) with storage encryption.
findings.title: RDS instance 'demo-public-db' storage is not encrypted

findings.description: Record 'static.example.org.' (CNAME) points at 'demo-gone.s3.amazonaws.com' (s3, takeover likely): no bucket 'demo-gone' in this account: anyone may create it.

evidence.check: no bucket 'demo-gone' in this account: anyone may create it

findings.remediation: Verify the target resource still exists and belongs to you; remove the record if not.
findings.title: Potential dangling DNS record: static.example.org.

findings.description: Instance 'i-0a1b2c3d4e5f60f03' (running) has HttpTokens 'optional' with the metadata endpoint enabled: SSRF can read instance metadata and user data (no role is attached).
findings.remediation: Set HttpTokens to 'required' to enforce IMDSv2 (or disable the metadata endpoint).
findings.title: Instance i-0a1b2c3d4e5f60f03 allows IMDSv1

findings.description: The IAM password policy is below common baselines: password reuse prevention None < 24.
findings.remediation: Set an account password policy: length >= 14, all character classes, reuse prevention 24.
findings.title: The account password policy is weak

findings.description: S3 bucket 'demo-vpce-bucket' gives anyone on the internet CAN_READ (actions: s3:getobject); the grant is conditional (strong restriction); not verified: s3:account-public-access-block-unknown.
findings.remediation: Remove the wildcard Principal or scope it with a principal-restricting condition (aws:PrincipalOrgID, aws:SourceVpce, aws:SourceArn); keep Block Public Access (RestrictPublicBuckets) on at account level.
findings.title: Bucket 'demo-vpce-bucket' is public through its bucket policy (CAN_READ)

account.description: Anchor for account-wide findings (hygiene, posture, collection gaps).
account.label: Account

account_admin.description: Administrator of the assessed account; the default path target.
account_admin.label: Account administrator

anonymous.description: The internet / any AWS account. Source of every public exposure (F-037).
anonymous.label: Anyone

cognito.description: Hands out role credentials; treated as a bridge (entered only through control edges).
cognito.label: Cognito identity pool

idp.description: IAM OIDC or SAML provider, or a well-known web identity provider.
idp.label: Identity provider

kms.description: A data gate, not data: CAN_DECRYPT is needed to read encrypted resources.
kms.label: KMS key

lambda.description: Unqualified function; versions and aliases are in props.qualifiers.
lambda.label: Lambda function

service_principal.description: Context only (who may assume a role on behalf of a service).
service_principal.label: AWS service principal

user.description: Long-term credentials: a leaked access key is a common entry point.
user.label: IAM user
